name: Adzviser Sprout Social
description:
Connect your Sprout Social data to Claude. No more exporting CSVs or uploading files, Adzviser brings your reporting data directly into the conversation.

Ask about impressions, engagements, and followers. Compare profiles, dig into how each network and post type performs, and understand what's changed over time. Whether you're checking last week's posts or putting together a monthly report, start with a question and let Claude build the analysis you need.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Adzviser Sprout Social to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Adzviser Sprout Social to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://sprout-social.mcp.adzviser.com/http. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Adzviser Sprout Social MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Adzviser Sprout Social provides these MCP tools: list_metrics_and_breakdowns_sprout_social, list_workspace, and retrieve_reporting_data.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Adzviser Sprout Social?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Adzviser Sprout Social in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.

_published_faq.name: Does Adzviser Sprout Social MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Adzviser Sprout Social requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Adzviser Sprout Social is developed by Adzviser LLC. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
